games.title: Lunar Limit
games.author: Pubby

description.en: A one-screen NES arena shooter. The ship fires on its own; you fly and aim. Code is MIT. Music and sounds by MovieMovies1 are CC BY 4.0.
description.ar: لعبة إطلاق نار على شاشة واحدة لجهاز العائلة. السفينة تطلق وحدها، وأنت تطير وتصوب. الكود برخصة MIT، والموسيقى والأصوات من MovieMovies1 برخصة CC BY 4.0.

games.permissionNote: LICENSE.txt in the author's repository grants MIT for the code and CC BY 4.0 for MovieMovies1's music and sounds.

compatibility.controller: The player maps a keyboard and the Gamepad API. This sandbox has no physical pad, so a controller was not tested.
compatibility.saves: The player has four manual slots plus autosave. Save and load were not pressed in this pass.
compatibility.performance: Title screen and HUD in headless Chromium, and again in Chrome with a 390x844 Android viewport. WebKit 18.4 with an iPhone viewport did not reach the player. See docs/evidence/launch/lunar-limit.png and lunar-limit-android.png.

games.title: Concentration Room
games.author: Damian Yerrick

description.en: A GPL-3.0 NES card game by Damian Yerrick. Flip two emblems and clear the table. The ROM is the author's v0.02a release.
description.ar: لعبة بطاقات لجهاز العائلة من داميان يريك، برخصة GPL-3.0. اقلب شعارين وأفرغ الطاولة. الملف هو إصدار المؤلف v0.02a.

games.permissionNote: The repository LICENSE.txt is the GNU GPL version 3. Source is the linked repository.

compatibility.controller: The player maps a keyboard and the Gamepad API. This sandbox has no physical pad.
compatibility.saves: The player has four manual slots plus autosave.
compatibility.performance: Title menu reached in headless Chromium. See docs/evidence/launch/concentration-room.png.

games.title: Blind Jump
games.author: Evan Bowman

description.en: An MIT-licensed action adventure for the Game Boy Advance, with procedurally generated rooms. The file is the author's 2021.11.20.0 release.
description.ar: مغامرة حركة لجيم بوي أدفانس برخصة MIT، بغرف تُولَّد إجرائيًا. الملف هو إصدار المؤلف 2021.11.20.0.

games.permissionNote: The repository LICENSE is the MIT license, copyright 2019 Evan Bowman.

compatibility.controller: The player maps a keyboard and the Gamepad API. This sandbox has no physical pad.
compatibility.saves: The player has four manual slots plus autosave.
compatibility.performance: Language select reached in headless Chromium. See docs/evidence/launch/blind-jump.png.

games.title: Super Mario Bros.
games.author: Nintendo

description.en: Nintendo's 1985 NES platformer. EmuRM does not include the ROM. Choose a file you already have; it stays in this browser.
description.ar: لعبة منصات من نينتندو عام 1985 على جهاز العائلة. EmuRM لا يتضمن ملف اللعبة. اختر ملفًا تملكه، ويبقى داخل هذا المتصفح.

games.permissionNote: No redistribution license. Nintendo holds the game. Browser decompilations that embed the ROM are not linked or hosted.

compatibility.controller: Same player as other NES games, once your file is loaded.
compatibility.saves: Same save slots as other NES games, once your file is loaded. Not exercised with this title.
compatibility.performance: Not launched. A commercial ROM was not obtained.

games.permissionNote: No redistribution license. The Snes9x core already used by EmuRM is itself non-commercial.

compatibility.controller: Same player as other SNES games, once your file is loaded.

games.title: Super Mario 64
games.author: Nintendo

description.en: Nintendo's 1996 Nintendo 64 platformer. The decompilation repository does not include the game data. EmuRM will not build or host a ROM. Load your own .z64 or .n64 locally.
description.ar: لعبة منصات من نينتندو عام 1996 على نينتندو 64. مستودع التفكيك لا يتضمن بيانات اللعبة. EmuRM لا يبني الملف ولا يستضيفه. حمّل ملفك بصيغة z64 أو n64 محليًا.

games.permissionNote: The sm64 decomp is source for the code. Nintendo's assets are not licensed for redistribution. Third-party web builds that embed the ROM are not linked.

compatibility.controller: The bundled N64 core is aimed at a desktop-class GPU.
compatibility.performance: Not launched. The bundled core notes a desktop-class GPU.

games.title: Crash Bandicoot
games.author: Naughty Dog

description.en: Naughty Dog's 1996 PlayStation platformer. EmuRM does not include a disc image. Load your own .cue/.bin or .chd locally. A BIOS is optional; the core has HLE.
description.ar: لعبة منصات من نوتي دوغ عام 1996 على بلايستيشن. EmuRM لا يتضمن صورة القرص. حمّل ملفك بصيغة cue و bin أو chd محليًا. البيوس اختياري لأن النواة فيها محاكاة عالية المستوى.

games.permissionNote: No redistribution license. Sony and Naughty Dog hold the game. Browser copies found in public catalogs were not linked.

compatibility.controller: PlayStation pad mapping exists in the player. Not exercised with this title.
compatibility.performance: Not launched. PS1 speed depends on the device.

games.title: Crash Bash
games.author: Eurocom

description.en: Eurocom's 2000 PlayStation party game. It is not hosted. Load your own disc image locally. Sites that stream a copy in the browser were rejected.
description.ar: لعبة جماعية من يوروكوم عام 2000 على بلايستيشن. غير مستضافة. حمّل صورة قرصك محليًا. رُفضت المواقع التي تبث نسخة داخل المتصفح.

games.permissionNote: No redistribution license. A browser directory that lists Crash Bash Online was rejected because it does not show a license to embed the game.

games.title: Pepsiman
games.author: KID

description.en: KID's 1999 PlayStation action game. No license allowing redistribution was found. EmuRM does not host or link a disc image. Load your own locally.
description.ar: لعبة أكشن من كيد عام 1999 على بلايستيشن. لم يُعثر على ترخيص يسمح بإعادة التوزيع. EmuRM لا يستضيف صورة القرص ولا يربطها. حمّل ملفك محليًا.

games.permissionNote: Commercial release by KID. Wikipedia documents the game; it is not a download. No rights holder grant was found.

games.title: Tomb Raider
games.author: Core Design

description.en: Core Design's 1996 Tomb Raider. OpenLara's engine is BSD-2-Clause, but its public web demo bundles the game's own levels. EmuRM does not embed that demo. Load your own PlayStation disc image locally.
description.ar: تومب رايدر من كور ديزاين عام 1996. محرك OpenLara برخصة BSD-2-Clause، لكن العرض العام على الويب يضم مراحل اللعبة نفسها. EmuRM لا يضمّن ذلك العرض. حمّل صورة قرص بلايستيشن الخاصة بك محليًا.

games.permissionNote: OpenLara LICENSE is BSD-2-Clause for the engine only. The README's WebGL demo includes a Tomb Raider level. That data was not copied or iframed.

compatibility.performance: Not launched. OpenLara's web demo was not used.
